records.localization_note: Rafael Castor is the fixed speaker in the knife exchange. FI in his reply resolves separately to Hodram's given name.
Hodram Bergstrom is the ordinary nameplate. The monk addresses his office and Diogo uses the controlled surname.
Maria Li is the fixed speaker whose argument turns the Sao Jorge encounter toward recruitment. Her company-name macro identifies her affiliation.
Claudio Manaus is Rafael's crewmate who proposes the knife and payment bargain. Rafael uses Claudio in his reply.
Julio Erneco calls Cristina his granddaughter. The short header and the spoken family relationship are distinct.
Xien Yan answers the bandit's grievance about the town guard. He does not speak Maria's subsequent offer.
Emilio Ferog retains the registered ASCII F. His triumphant interjection fits the springing of the village trap.
Gerhard Adernkatz objects to threats against the village and works through the riddles with Hodram. Crew dialogue uses his given name as established.
Charles Rochefort interrupts the raid and later reminds the captain about sail handling. Both remain in his own name.
Carlo Sinat interprets the jade offerings, including their significance in two regions.
Manuel Almeida asks for the ship's heading and appears in the village trap exchange. Preserve his name separately from the tutorial panels.
Diogo Escante is his short header. Hodram uses Diogo de Escante in the confrontation, with the separate catalogue name component retained.
Senior Monk reflects the clean honorific title and the character's formal account of the Yuan invasion.
Priest fits the officiant who greets pilgrims with a cross and leads the prayer.
Sailor is the established generic label for the injured crewmate. The FE injury notice names no specific actor.
Villager is the role who recognizes fellow believers and offers the inherited lamp. The source gives no personal name.
Boy is the source role and the child speaks to his actual grandfather. His friendly farewell to Hodram implies no additional family tie.
Mysterious Old Man preserves the source role and his initially unknown identity. His relationship to the boy is named in the body dialogue.
Sect Leader identifies the man directing the sect and the planned raid. No rank or personal name is established.
Follower identifies the group answering the Sect Leader. Preserve the registered ordinary-font F.
Villager is the role who speaks about ownership of the knife and suggests returning. This is a separate source actor from the villager with the lamp.
Bandit preserves the source role during the confrontation and the beginning of the alliance. The scene supplies no personal name.
Donna is the registered name of the woman recommending Santiago Cathedral. Keep the given name as it appears in the source name field.
Benazir is the approved name of the woman who repays the gift with a lead about India.
